kv17.10:1.4: Nanu Bhagavā dipadānaṃ aggo, dipadānaṃ seṭṭho, dipadānaṃ pamokkho, dipadānaṃ uttamo, dipadānaṃ pavaro asamo asamasamo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo ti?
kv17.10:1.6: Hañci Bhagavā dipadānaṃ aggo, dipadānaṃ seṭṭho, dipadānaṃ pamokkho, dipadānaṃ uttamo, dipadānaṃ pavaro asamo asamasamo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.10:2.7: Hañci n' atthi keci Buddhena samasamo
kv17.10:2.8: sīlena samādhinā paññāya, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.10:4.2: Buddhena seṭṭho ca samo ca vijjati,
kv17.10:5.3: Tena hi Buddhassa dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti. Na vattabbaṃ "Buddhassa dinnaṃ mahap- phalan ti" kathā. 1. Dāyakato va
